narr: Slow-moving thunderstorms over the Dark Canyon Arroyo watershed led to flash flooding of some roads and low-water crossings.
ev: Eddy County Emergency Management reported three swift water rescues from the Dark Canyon Arroyo and multiple road closures. The cost of property damage is an estimation.
lsr: Eddy County EM reported three swift water rescues out of Dark Canyon arroyo. Multiple road closures were also reported.
